rules.name: Assumption Control
rules.purpose: Surface uncertain requirements before implementation so agents do not silently choose a risky interpretation.
triggers: The request has multiple plausible interpretations.
The change touches data, auth, security, public claims, or broad behavior.
failureModes: Agent implements hidden assumptions as if they were confirmed requirements.
remediation: Pause, name the ambiguity, and get the missing decision before mutating high-risk files.

rules.name: Scope Minimization
rules.purpose: Keep implementation bounded to the requested outcome and block speculative features or abstractions.
triggers: The implementation starts adding optional flexibility, new concepts, or unrequested behaviors.
A single-use helper or new module appears before repeated complexity exists.
failureModes: Agent ships an overbuilt solution that is harder to test, review, and maintain.
remediation: Replace speculative structure with the smallest change that satisfies the stated done criteria.

rules.name: Diff Hygiene
rules.purpose: Preserve unrelated code, comments, formatting, and behavior while cleaning up only artifacts created by the current change.
triggers: The patch changes nearby formatting, comments, names, or control flow outside the requested scope.
The patch creates unused imports, variables, files, or helper functions.
failureModes: Agent introduces review noise or behavior drift through drive-by cleanup.
remediation: Revert unrelated edits, preserve local style, and remove only unused artifacts introduced by the current patch.

rules.name: Verification Loop
rules.purpose: Convert work into success criteria and evidence so completion claims are tied to observed checks.
triggers: The request has a user-visible or production-facing outcome.
A bug fix, refactor, or release action needs proof that behavior improved without regression.
failureModes: Agent declares success from intent rather than a reproducible check or observed evidence.
remediation: Record the success criteria, run the smallest relevant checks, and report any unverified areas explicitly.
